lines.en: Moo, let us walk over to the mycelium.
These on my back ride along steady.
The grass on Mushroom Island is soft.
Slow steps, I fear losing a mushroom.
Four hooves, one moo for every step.
I walk around the big red mushroom.
Farther out, the mycelium grows richer.
I turn my head to check on my herd.

lines.zh: 走路要晃一点，蘑菇才透气。
lines.en: A wobble lets my mushrooms breathe.
The red caps on my back sway along.
Do not rush me, cows are slow.
This island is small and I know it.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，菌丝更密。
lines.en: The mycelium thickens where I tread.
Two steps, then a mouthful of grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着岛边慢慢走一圈。
lines.en: I take a slow turn around the island rim.

lines.zh: 蹄子底下全是软的菌丝。
lines.en: Soft mycelium under every hoof.
Moo, I am chewing on something.

lines.zh: 我背上的蘑菇今天长了一点。
lines.en: My mushrooms grew a little today.

lines.zh: 天有点阴，蘑菇喜欢这样。
lines.en: A cloudy sky, the mushrooms like it.
Who is counting the mushrooms on me?
Standing still, I am still growing mushrooms.
The wind off the sea tastes of salt.
I flick my tail at a fly.
Only my herd and I on this island.
I burp and it smells of fungus.

lines.zh: 阳光照到背上，蘑菇就精神。
lines.en: Sun on my back perks the mushrooms up.

lines.zh: 背上的蘑菇又厚了一层。
lines.en: The mushrooms on my back grew another layer.

lines.zh: 有蘑菇在我耳朵边冒出来。
lines.en: A mushroom is sprouting by my ear.

lines.zh: 我低头，看见自己的影子很圆。
lines.en: I look down, my shadow is very round.

lines.zh: 这岛安静得只剩我嚼草。
lines.en: So quiet here only my chewing sounds.
A chicken circles my hooves.

lines.zh: 我抬头，蘑菇岛的树很高。
lines.en: I look up. The mushroom island trees are tall.
Moo? Did you come from the sea?

lines.zh: 你手里没有麦子，我不动。
lines.en: No wheat in your hand, so I stay.
Do not stare at my back, those are mine.
Have you come to milk me?

lines.zh: 我认识你，你上次拿碗来的。
lines.en: I know you, you came with a bowl before.
Keep back, my mushrooms bruise easily.

lines.zh: 你的船停在哪？这岛少有人来。
lines.en: Where is your boat? Few come here.
You smell of iron.

lines.zh: 你要剪我的蘑菇？先问一声。
lines.en: Shearing my mushrooms? Ask me first.
I tilt my head, and so do you.
Moo, so you are that player.

lines.zh: 我在想，你会不会给我麦子。
lines.en: I wonder whether you brought wheat.
Moo! Why did you hit me?
A mushroom fell off my back.
It hurts, my horn is crooked.
Stop, I am only a cow.
I dodge sideways but cannot escape.
You made me bellow, moo.
I bellow loudly, it truly hurts.

lines.zh: 我四条腿发软，站不住了。
lines.en: My four legs go weak, I cannot stand.
You knocked my mushrooms all askew.
Moo, I will go farther away.
Wheat! You should have said so.
That bunch of wheat, hold it higher.
I smell wheat, moo.
One handful and I will follow.
You reach out, and here I come.
My four legs will not obey me.
Wheat tastes best in my mouth.
Hold still, I cannot see the stalks.

lines.zh: 你手里有麦子？我这蘑菇岛没这味。
lines.en: Wheat? Nothing on Mushroom Island smells like that.
My head is down, feed me already.
You still have wheat in your pocket, yes?

lines.zh: 我舔舔嘴，等你再伸一次手。
lines.en: I lick my lips for another handful.

lines.zh: 这岛上没有麦，只有你带来。
lines.en: No wheat grows here, only what you bring.
Moo moo, I am hurrying you along.

lines.zh: 麦子在袋子里，我闻到了。
lines.en: Wheat in your bag. I smell it.
Walk ahead. I'll follow.
Moo! You nearly knocked my mushrooms off.
Careful, the mushrooms will fall off.
I am this big, go around me.
Do not shove, four hooves are unsteady.
You squeezed in and I tilted over.
My horns are not that hard, no fear.
One shove from you and my caps sway.

lines.zh: 你走你的，我走我的，别挤。
lines.en: You go yours, I go mine, no shoving.
I am round, you will bounce off me.
Sorry, moo, I did not see you there.
Moo, are you red-skinned too?
Our mushrooms make a matching pair.
Standing close together keeps us warm.

lines.zh: 等小哞菇出来，背上就有小蘑菇。
lines.en: The calf will come with tiny mushrooms.

lines.zh: 你舔我一下，我舔你一下。
lines.en: You lick me, and I lick you.
Enough wheat, and this is what follows.
I am slow, you are slow, perfect.
Mind my hooves, please.
We lower our heads, nose to nose.
The island will be livelier after this.

lines.zh: 这朵蘑菇，我捡起来看看。
lines.en: This mushroom, let me pick it up.
Wheat on the ground? Mine.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起来，放哪好呢。
lines.en: I pick it up, where should it go?
This cannot be food, surely.

lines.zh: 我把它塞到背上的蘑菇中间。
lines.en: I tuck it among my back mushrooms.
Even a cow picks up what falls.
I sniff it first, then decide.
This one is too small for me.
I carry it off the mycelium patch.

lines.zh: 地上东西都被我踩进菌丝里了。
lines.en: I tread everything into the mycelium.
Something moves over there, moo.
I do not like that shadow.
A wolf? I should be going.
I stare, and it stares back.
It has come much too close.
My horns are starting to itch.
It is sniffing at my mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，挡在同伴前面。
lines.en: One step forward, in front of the herd.
It may not linger on my island.
I am ready to run.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，看它要干什么。
lines.en: I follow it to see what it wants.

lines.zh: 别过来，我蹄子也不好惹。
lines.en: Keep away, these hooves can hit.
My head is down, that is a warning.
Let it come near and my horns will answer.
One moo and it should understand.
I turn slowly to face it.
The herd and I all watch it.
It backed off, I keep watching.
I stand before the mycelium.
One more step and, moo.
I shoved it once, just once.
Moo! Keep off my mushrooms.
I push with my horns, not to hurt.
It got shoved aside by me.

lines.zh: 我这一下不重，但够它记住。
lines.en: Not heavy, but it will remember.
I raise a front hoof and stomp.
Do not corner a cow, cows charge.
I shove it off the mycelium.

lines.zh: 我的角碰到它了，响了一声。
lines.en: My horn struck it with a clack.
Moo, walk away and I stop.
Moo, I open my eyes on mycelium.
Mushroom Island, here again.

lines.zh: 我背上的蘑菇，一出生就有。
lines.en: My mushrooms were there from birth.
Enough light, and here I am.
I test the mycelium under my hooves.
Mother is beside me, I follow.
The island has one more cow.

lines.zh: 我抖抖身子，蘑菇晃了晃。
lines.en: I shake and my mushrooms wobble.

lines.zh: 海风吹过来，我打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: Sea wind blows, I sneeze.
Barely standing, already hungry for grass.
My mushrooms fear fire, moo!

lines.zh: 我从菌丝崖边滚了下来。
lines.en: I tumbled down the mycelium ledge.
Water went straight up my nose.
The blast left my ears ringing.
Something stuck into my back.
That light leaves me numb all over.
I am hungry and my stomach complains.
Lightning hit my horn, it tingles.
I fell into a place with no bottom.
